<page>
 Kennedy & Johnson LLP
 Sugar Land, TX
 Phone 832-555-5054
 Letter of Representation
22 Dec 2023
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1123
Our client: Steven Moore
Date of loss: 15 Dec 2023
Dear Claims Representative:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the interests of our client in connection with the parking lot collision described
in the claim you have opened. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our
client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already
been in touch with our client, please let us know so we can address it.
We ask that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to your insured for this
loss, along with a copy of the declarations page. Our client has ssutained injuries that are still being evaluated, and we need this
information to assess the full scope of available coverage.
Please also take steps now to preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or
surveillance footage, vehicle data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, recorded statements, and any written reports. Routine deletion
or disposal of these materials should be suspended until this matter is resolved. We look forward to your prompt written
confirmation that these requests have been received and will be honored.
Sincerely,
David Richardson
Kennedy & Johnson LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
